Monitoring.Label: Carlson Guard Active Monitoring
Monitoring.Description: Single monitoring option that updates automatically with the hardware subtotal.
Monitoring.NoneDescription: Leave unchecked for a fabrication-only build.

UI.HeroSubtitle: Build and price your infrastructure package using a scalable fabrication framework powered by centralized product data.
UI.CustomDescription: Start from your selected enclosure and configure from the ground up.
UI.PremadeModeText: Mode: Pre-built package with optional upgrades
UI.PremadeUpgradeNote: Base package includes its core switching and power architecture. Add upgrades below as needed.
UI.SurgeProtectionDescription: Choose optional surge protection sized by protected port count. This adds to termination requirements.
UI.EnclosureNote: Final enclosure dimensions will be confirmed with you before order processing. We will try to source to spec, but availability and lead time may require an equivalent size.
UI.Disclaimer: Carlson Solutions LLC is a specialized manufacturer. We fabricate and configure technical hardware units. We do NOT provide on-site installation, electrical wiring, or cable pulling. Customers are responsible for mounting and hiring licensed professionals for all field wiring.

InfoTexts.FabricationFee: Covers design complexity, calibration overhead, and risk-adjusted build operations beyond raw hardware cost.
InfoTexts.EstimatedTax: Estimated using configured tax rate and final fabrication total; final invoice may vary by jurisdiction.
InfoTexts.EstimatedShipping: Estimated shipping reserve based on packaging class and delivery profile.
InfoTexts.CalibrationFee: One-time calibration and commissioning fee due now when active monitoring is selected.
InfoTexts.MonitoringMonthly: Subscription estimate updates with hardware complexity: 49.99 + (Hardware Subtotal x 0.015).
InfoTexts.Deposit: Required to secure production capacity and kickoff technical review. Applied against final balance.

FeatureCards.title: Made-to-Order, Fully Customizable
FeatureCards.description: Every package is built to your exact site requirements, with enclosure size, ports, power, and layout matched to the job.

FeatureCards.title: Precision Termination Testing
FeatureCards.description: Every termination is digitally wire-mapped and verified for PoE++ power delivery and clean 10G data integrity before the build leaves our shop.

FeatureCards.title: Guaranteed Port Performance
FeatureCards.description: You are not just paying for the plug. You are paying for verified, maximum-rated port performance with no packet loss or power drops when the system goes live.

FeatureCards.title: Design Review Deposit ($500)
FeatureCards.description: Your $500 deposit secures your build slot and initiates a 1-on-1 technical review of your site requirements before we begin fabrication.
